[SWS_DM_01227] Configuration of authentication types
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04251
⌈
If the sub function DiagnosticProofOfOwnership of the
DiagnosticAuthentica-
tion DiagnosticServiceInstance
is configured, the Diagnostic Manager shall
mandatorily require one of the following sub functions to be configured as well:
• DiagnosticVerifyCertificateUnidirectional
• DiagnosticVerifyCertificateBidirectional
⌋
